name: Formosa Taffeta Co., Ltd.
summary: Formosa Taffeta Co., Ltd. operates in the textile industry in Taiwan and Asia. The company offers eco-friendly, sports and outdoor, safety, and lifestyle fabrics. It also offers umbrella, carbon fiber, spun yarn, tire cord, and PE plastic bags.
